decisions.alternatives_note: NONE ENUMERATED DETERMINISTICALLY -- polymer_rules.json:classes.PHAL has no forcefield_alternatives, and this layer will not invent one. The moiety probe names what actually types this SMILES; the literature critic may name a candidate on the evidence.

findings: Critic verdict on D-01_ff is no_evidence with low confidence and no supporting_dois or suggested_override, so opls/2024/opls-aa stays. On-chemistry support already exists in the autofill evidence: Watkins & Jorgensen 2001 fitted the OPLS-AA perfluoroalkane torsions and F LJ terms against PTFE, C4F10 and C5F12. The dedicated PTFE force fields the critic found (Borodin/Smith/Bedrov 2002, DOI 10.1021/jp026158i; AMBER-compatible 2024, DOI 10.1515/chem-2024-0072) cannot be selected: neither is in the preferred_ff enum, and neither has an accessible quantitative comparison. They are noted as unexplored alternatives, not acted on.

The Viton A caution (10.1016/j.ces.2019.05.007: OPLS-derived fields too soft and under-packed vs PCFF) is on a VDF/HFP copolymer, not all-CF2 PTFE. PCFF has no fluorocarbon parameterization per the class note, so switching to it is not justified. Keep the caution: if K or density comes back low, suspect the force field before the protocol.

No experimental_* overrides. The SMILES exactly matches PHAL member_smiles.PTFE, and the curated experimental_tg_K.PTFE=160 already resolves (tg success criterion t_range_brackets_exp_tg=160), so re-pinning adds nothing. The class curates no PTFE density or K, so both stay unset rather than guessed. The crystalline ML-FF values (2.136 g/cm3, 137.5 GPa Young's modulus, 10.1021/acs.jpclett.1c01140) are not amorphous targets and are not used. The 100-550 K Tg sweep brackets both candidate Tg values, but grade any Tg result against 160 K with the ambiguity in mind.

Advisory CHEM_BUILD_RISK (fluoroalkyl failed 25% of 67 EMC trial builds, 1.7x baseline) cannot be acted on through overrides: the force-field probe is a planning-CLI flag, not an allowlisted key. D-01's parameter_coverage evidence already says typing is NOT MEASURED, and polymer_rules warns to check that EMC assigns the CF2 atom types. The build stage is the real test. If it fails on typing, re-plan with --with-ff-probe instead of switching force fields by hand.

Other resolved params checked and kept: T_equil_K=700 is above PTFE's Tm (~600 K); density_initial_gcm3=0.89 (~0.45x amorphous PTFE) is the class's deliberate low-density start against ordered packing; pppm/11 A cutoff matches the class curation and the chemistry layer's implied electrostatics (pppm).

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PHAL.ff_note: OPLS-AA via EMC: native Watkins & Jorgensen 2001 F LJ parameters (opls_965: sigma=2.95 A, epsilon=0.053 kcal/mol) cover CF2/CF3 backbones; PCFF lacks fluorocarbon parameterization and TraPPE-UA/GAFF2 are not the chemistry-appropriate fit for this backbone. Afzal2021 reports halogen-class R2=0.87, MAE=20.8K for OPLS3e. PVDF's mixed CF2-CH2 dihedrals use general OPLS-AA CT/HC types (Byutner2000 provides a bespoke density-target reference, not the routing justification itself). CAUTION: a same-family fluoropolymer comparison (Viton A, VDF/HFP) reports OPLS-derived fields producing systematically too-soft, under-packed structures relative to PCFF -- qualitative only, worth watching if PHAL modulus/K results come back low. OPLS-AA's own founding paper never tested a fluorine-containing liquid, so today's routing is an extrapolation beyond its stated scope, consistent with (not contradicted by) the Viton A caution.

evidence.citation: Hayashi, Y. et al. RadonPy: Automated Physical Property Calculation using All-atom Classical Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Polymer Informatics. npj Comput. Mater. 2022, 8, 222.
evidence.claim: High-throughput GAFF2 polymer MD; 1 ns NVT anneal 300→700 K; 10 chains ~10,000 atoms; LAMMPS; systematic Tg and density for 1070+ polymers. Primary reference for nchain, dp, and forcefield defaults.

evidence.citation: Afzal, M. A. F. et al. High-Throughput Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Validation of Thermophysical Properties of Polymers for Various Applications. ACS Appl. Polym. Mater. 2021, 3, 2, 620–630.
evidence.claim: OPLS3e GPU-based Tg for 315 polymers; validates electrostatics impact on polar vs apolar polymers. lj/cut acceptable only when backbone charge < 0.1 e.

evidence.citation: Byutner, O. G.; Smith, G. D. Quantum Chemistry Based Force Field for Simulations of Poly(vinylidene fluoride). Macromolecules 2000, 33, 4264–4270.
evidence.claim: QM-derived all-atom FF for PVDF: oligomer geometries, conformational energies, and PVDF melt density 10–310°C validated against experiment. Dihedral parameters for CF2–CH2–CF2 backbone. Primary PHAL-class PVDF FF reference; used to validate OPLS-AA path via EMC.

evidence.citation: Watkins, E. K.; Jorgensen, W. L. Perfluoroalkanes: Conformational Analysis and Liquid-State Properties from ab Initio and Monte Carlo Calculations. J. Phys. Chem. A 2001, 105, 4118–4125.
evidence.claim: OPLS-AA LJ parameters for perfluoroalkanes: F sigma=2.95 Å, epsilon=0.053 kcal/mol (opls_965). Torsional parameters from LMP2/HF/6-31G* and MC validation on PTFE/C4F10/C5F12. Provides the fluorine LJ patch applied in GAFF2_mod for PHAL class to correct default GAFF2 F parameters.
